note: What a server sends to create a turret of its own choosing. A client first deletes any object it holds under the same id, and does nothing more where it cannot make the character. The header carries zero.

fields.name: owner
fields.note: The unit credited with the gold for its kills, or zero for none.

fields.name: node
fields.note: The network node it belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The turret's object name. A client reads to the first zero byte.

fields.name: character
fields.note: Its character, that is, its model.

fields.name: deathDelay
fields.note: Seconds after it dies before its model is changed or taken away.

bits.name: invulnerable
bits.note: Set where it takes no damage.

bits.name: targetable
bits.note: Set where it can be targeted.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: targetableBy
fields.note: Who may target it. A client compares the whole value with these and gives no meaning to others.
